user.title: Set up your air conditioner
user.description:
IRBridge controls an air conditioner by generating the infrared signals its remote would send — so every temperature and mode works, with nothing to record first.

To do that it needs to know which **protocol** your unit speaks: the language of those signals. The brand on the front is only a hint, so IRBridge will send a test command and let you tell it whether the unit reacted.

Have the air conditioner in sight and the blaster pointed at it before you continue.

data.title: Name
data.mode: How should we find the protocol?

data_description.title: What this device will be called in Home Assistant, for example "Bedroom AC".
data_description.infrared_entity_id: The IR blaster that will transmit to this unit.
data_description.mode: Guided tries each of the {total} known protocols in turn. Expert lets you choose, if you already know which one you need.

protocol.title: Choose a protocol
protocol.description: Each protocol covers a family of air conditioners, listed by the brands known to use it. If yours is not named, pick the closest and test it anyway — brands share protocols more often than they advertise.

test.title: Did the air conditioner react?
test.description:
IRBridge just sent **cool, {temp} °C** using the **{protocol}** protocol ({brands}).

Look at the unit. If it beeped, turned on, or its display now reads {temp} °C, that is the right protocol.

If nothing happened, uncheck the box and IRBridge will try another one. Nothing is saved until you confirm.

error.test_failed: That protocol got no reaction. Pick another one and try again.
error.none_worked: None of the protocols got a reaction. Check that the blaster is powered, in range and pointing at the unit, then try one again. If your air conditioner uses a protocol IRBridge does not know yet, please open an issue on GitHub — a new protocol starts from captured samples.
error.send_failed: The blaster could not send the test: {error}

abort.infrared_unavailable: This Home Assistant version has no infrared platform. IRBridge requires Home Assistant 2026.7 or newer.

init.title: Change protocol or blaster
init.description: Your current settings keep working until a new choice has been tested. IRBridge will send a command and ask whether the unit reacted before saving anything.

test.title: Did the air conditioner react?
test.description:
IRBridge just sent **cool, {temp} °C** using the **{protocol}** protocol ({brands}).

If the unit reacted, confirm below to save. If nothing happened, uncheck the box and pick another protocol — your current settings are untouched either way.

error.test_failed: That protocol got no reaction. Pick another one and try again.
error.send_failed: The blaster could not send the test: {error}
